items.title: S&P Global projects 7% growth for India through 2028
items.summary: In its Economic Outlook Asia-Pacific Q1 2027 report, S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI) projects that India will grow at 7% this fiscal year and again in the year to March 2028, a pace that would rank the country among the fastest-expanding economies in the Asia-Pacific region in 2027. According to the outlook, robust expansion will be accompanied by price pressures that refuse to ease.

items.title: S&P revises PROG Holdings outlook to stable on rapid post-deal deleveraging

items.title: S&P upgrades E.W. Scripps to ‘B-’ on cost cuts and debt reduction progress
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded E. W. Scripps Co (NASDAQ:SSP) issuer credit rating to ‘B-’ from ‘CCC+’ with a stable outlook, signaling growing confidence in the broadcaster’s ability to sustain positive free operating cash flow through a full political cycle. The ratings agency also lifted issue-level ratings across the company's debt stack, including raising its first-lien senior secured debt to ‘B+’ from ‘B’ and its second-lien senior secured debt to ‘B-’ from ‘CCC+’.

items.title: S&P joins Fitch in downgrading Turkish white goods maker Arcelik on “ongoing challenges”
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has moved to downgrade Turkish white goods producer Arcelik (Istanbul/ARCLK) by one notch to B, five notches below investment grade, citing ongoing business challenges delaying deleveraging prospects, according to a statement released by the international rating agency. The assigned outlook, meanwhile, remains negative.
